skymen_text_glyph.name: Text Glyph
skymen_text_glyph.description: Text object drawn using pmdrs's glyph engine. Supports more BBCode tags than the default text object and handles kerning better.

text.name: Text
text.desc: The text to display. Supports BBCode when enabled.

bbcode.name: Enable BBCode
bbcode.desc: Parse BBCode tags like [b], [color=red] and [size=20] in the text.

fontInfo.name: Font files
fontInfo.desc: Fonts must be .ttf or .otf files in the project's Fonts folder. WOFF and variable fonts are not supported.

font.name: Font
font.desc: Font family. Must match a .ttf or .otf file in the project's Fonts folder.

lineHeight.name: Line height
lineHeight.desc: Extra pixels added to every line. Can be negative.

bold.name: Bold
bold.desc: Use the Bold font file when present, otherwise embolden the regular face.

italic.name: Italic
italic.desc: Use the Italic font file when present, otherwise slant the regular face.

alignX.name: Horizontal alignment
alignX.desc: Where each line sits in the box: 0 is the left edge, 0.5 the center, 1 the right edge.

alignY.name: Vertical alignment
alignY.desc: Where the text block sits in the box: 0 is the top, 0.5 the middle, 1 the bottom.

justify.name: Justify
justify.desc: Stretch word spacing so lines fill the box width. The last line of a paragraph follows the horizontal alignment unless every line is justified.

wrap.name: Wrapping
wrap.desc: Break lines between words, between characters, or only at line breaks in the text.

overflow.name: Overflow
overflow.desc: Let text extend past the bottom of the box. When off, lines that do not fit inside the box are not drawn.

ellipsis.name: Ellipsis
ellipsis.desc: Cut text that does not fit the box and end it with an ellipsis (…).

maxLines.name: Max lines
maxLines.desc: Highest number of lines to lay out. 0 means no limit. Pairs well with Ellipsis.

direction.name: Text direction
direction.desc: Base paragraph direction. Auto picks it from the first strong character.

originX.name: Origin X
originX.desc: Horizontal origin as a fraction of the width: 0 is the left edge, 1 the right edge.

originY.name: Origin Y
originY.desc: Vertical origin as a fraction of the height: 0 is the top edge, 1 the bottom edge.

iconSet.name: Icon set
iconSet.desc: A Sprite whose animations are used by [icon=animation] tags. The Sprite needs at least one instance in the layout.

spacingGroup.name: Spacing
spacingGroup.desc: Letter, word and paragraph spacing, columns and justify tuning.

letterSpacing.name: Letter spacing
letterSpacing.desc: Extra pixels after every character. Can be negative.

wordSpacing.name: Word spacing
wordSpacing.desc: Extra pixels after every space. Can be negative.

paragraphSpacing.name: Paragraph spacing
paragraphSpacing.desc: Extra pixels between paragraphs, meaning after every line break in the text.

columns.name: Columns
columns.desc: Flow the text through this many columns inside the box, filling each column to the box height in turn.

justifyMinWordSpace.name: Justify: min word space
justifyMinWordSpace.desc: When justifying, a space may shrink to this multiple of its natural width. 1 never shrinks.

justifyMaxWordSpace.name: Justify: max word space
justifyMaxWordSpace.desc: When justifying, a space may grow to this multiple of its natural width before letters spread apart. 0 means no limit.

justifyLetterSpace.name: Justify: letter space
justifyLetterSpace.desc: Most extra pixels allowed between letters when justifying once word spaces reach their maximum.

AddFlowExclusion.display-text: Flow text around [i]{0}[/i] on [i]{1}[/i] side with margin [i]{2}[/i]
AddFlowExclusion.description: Text wraps around the picked instances. Sprites use their collision polygon, anything else its bounding box. The layout follows them as they move.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The picked instances to flow around.

side.name: Wrap side
side.desc: Which side of the shape text may flow on.

margin.name: Margin
margin.desc: Clearance around the shape in pixels.

RemoveFlowExclusion.description: Stop wrapping around the picked instances.

SetIconSet.description: Use a Sprite's animations for [icon=animation] tags. The Sprite needs at least one instance in the layout.

object.name: Sprite
object.desc: The Sprite object whose animations are the icons.

LoadFont.description: Load a project font ahead of time so text using it appears without delay. Waits until the font is ready.

family.name: Font family
family.desc: Font family name, matching a project font file.

SetColumns.description: Flow the text through several columns inside the box, filling each to the box height in turn.

SetJustifyTuning.display-text: Set justify word space to [i]{0}[/i] to [i]{1}[/i] times, letter space up to [i]{2}[/i]
SetJustifyTuning.description: How far spaces may shrink and grow when justifying before letters spread apart. Max 0 means no limit.

min.name: Min word space
min.desc: Smallest multiple of the natural space width, 0.01 to 1.

max.name: Max word space
max.desc: Largest multiple of the natural space width, 0 for no limit.

letter.name: Letter space
letter.desc: Most extra pixels between letters once spaces are at their maximum.

SetLetterSpacing.description: Extra pixels after every character. Can be negative.

SetMaxLines.description: Highest number of lines to lay out. 0 means no limit.

SetParagraphSpacing.description: Extra pixels between paragraphs, meaning after every line break in the text.

SetWordSpacing.description: Extra pixels after every space. Can be negative.

AppendText.description: Add some text to the end of the existing text.

SetBBCodeEnabled.description: Enable or disable BBCode parsing of the text.

SetEllipsis.description: Cut text that does not fit the box and end it with an ellipsis (…).

enabled.name: Ellipsis
enabled.desc: Whether to cut overflowing text with an ellipsis.

SetFontColor.description: Set the text color, e.g. with rgb(255, 0, 0) or rgbEx(100, 0, 0).

color.name: Color
color.desc: Color value from rgb() or rgbEx().

SetFontFace.description: Set the font family and style. The family must match a .ttf or .otf project file.

family.name: Font family
family.desc: Font family name, matching a project font file.

SetFontSize.description: Set the font size in points.

SetHorizontalAlignment.description: Set the horizontal alignment of the text.

SetHorizontalAlignmentPercent.description: Set where each line sits in the box: 0 is the left edge, 50 the center, 100 the right edge. Any value in between works.

SetJustify.description: Stretch word spacing so lines fill the box width.

SetLineHeight.description: Set the extra pixels added to every line. Can be negative.

SetOrigin.description: Set the origin point as fractions of the size. (0, 0) is the top left corner, (0.5, 0.5) the center, (1, 1) the bottom right corner.

SetOriginX.description: Set the horizontal origin as a fraction of the width: 0 is the left edge, 0.5 the center, 1 the right edge.

SetOriginY.description: Set the vertical origin as a fraction of the height: 0 is the top edge, 0.5 the center, 1 the bottom edge.

SetOverflow.description: Let text extend past the bottom of the box. When off, lines that do not fit inside the box are not drawn.

enabled.name: Overflow
enabled.desc: Whether text may extend past the bottom of the box.

SetText.description: Set the text to display. BBCode tags are parsed when BBCode is enabled.

SetVerticalAlignment.description: Set the vertical alignment of the text.

SetVerticalAlignmentPercent.description: Set where the text block sits in the box: 0 is the top, 50 the middle, 100 the bottom. Any value in between works.

SetWrapping.description: Set whether lines break between words, between characters, or only at line breaks in the text.

TypewriterText.description: Set the text and reveal it one character at a time. The layout is computed once, so nothing shifts while typing.

duration.name: Duration
duration.desc: Time in seconds to reveal the whole text.

IsFontLoaded.description: True once a project font has been loaded and is ready to draw with.

HasTagAtPosition.description: True if the text under a layout position is inside a [tag=...] span with the given name.

CompareText.description: Compare the current text with a string.

caseSensitive.name: Case sensitive
caseSensitive.desc: Whether the comparison is case sensitive.

IsRunningTypewriterText.description: True while text is being revealed by the typewriter action.

OnTypewriterTextFinished.description: Triggered when the typewriter action has revealed the whole text.

TagAtPosition.description: The [tag=...] name under a layout position, or an empty string.

TagCount.description: How many separate [tag=...] spans with the given name the text contains.

TagHeight.description: The height of the nth [tag=...] span with the given name, in layout coordinates.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero based index of the span among spans with that tag.

TagWidth.description: The width of the nth [tag=...] span with the given name, in layout coordinates.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero based index of the span among spans with that tag.

TagX.description: The x of the nth [tag=...] span with the given name, in layout coordinates.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero based index of the span among spans with that tag.

TagY.description: The y of the nth [tag=...] span with the given name, in layout coordinates.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero based index of the span among spans with that tag.

FaceSize.description: The current font size in points.

LineHeight.description: The extra pixels added to every line.

OriginX.description: Horizontal origin as a fraction of the width, 0 (left) to 1 (right).

OriginY.description: Vertical origin as a fraction of the height, 0 (top) to 1 (bottom).

PlainText.description: The current text with BBCode tags removed.

Text.description: The current text, including BBCode tags.

TextHeight.description: Height of all laid out lines, in layout pixels.

TextWidth.description: Width of the widest line of laid out text, in layout pixels.
